# BMAD Enterprise Tech Writer

The Tech Writer persona in the BMAD framework produces user-facing documentation, developer guides, API references, and release notes aligned to delivered features.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/enterprise/techwriter.md`](../../agents/enterprise/techwriter.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-techwriter write documentation for [feature or API]
@bmad-techwriter create release notes for [version or sprint]
@bmad-techwriter update the developer guide with [new content]
```
